758 AM EDT Thu Oct 15 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 11 AM EDT THIS MORNING...

afternoon. Waves 1 to 2 ft. A slight chance of showers this morning,
then a chance of showers this afternoon.

.FRI...S winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. A chance
of showers. 
.FRI NIGHT...W winds 15 kt...becoming NW after midnight. Gusts up to
30 kt. Waves 2 to 3 ft. Showers.
.SAT...N winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts to 30 kt. Waves 4 ft. 
.SAT NIGHT...N winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts to 30 kt. Waves 4 ft. 
.SUN...NE winds 15 to 20 kt...diminishing to 5 to 10 kt. Waves
3 ft...subsiding to 1 ft.
